items.title: It’s Frighteningly Easy to Jailbreak Some Frontier AI Models
items.summary: I watched a new tool try to get around the model safeguards of four major frontier companies. You might be surprised by how they performed.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
items.summary: Novelists, journalists, and power LinkedIn posters are embracing first-person narratives and idiosyncrasies to avoid being mistaken for chat bots.
items.author: Emma Madden

items.title: Boomers Can’t Stop Gifting Their Grandkids AI-Generated Slop Books
items.summary: Parents are getting fed up with garbled bedtime stories that feature characters based on actual photos of their children.
items.author: Miles Klee
